title: Chococraft Gysahl Green Retexture
description: A simple retexture of the Gysahl Green blocks from Chococraft.
body:
## About

This is just a pretty simple retexture of the Gysahl Greens from [Chococraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/chococraft).

Presently only affects the block textures (not the item textures).

## Future Plans

At least for now, none really?

I only did this for my own playthrough with the mod as I did not like how the original textures contrasted so heavily against other minecraft textures, and don't care as much about the item textures themselves, so no promises on me ever doing those.
